action.name: Module Chrome & Collapse
action.description: Global defaults for LOOM module title bars and collapse behavior. Projects and individual modules can override them.

admin_settings.title: Module Chrome & Collapse
admin_settings.description: Global defaults. Each project can inherit or override these, and each project module can override the project policy.

fields.label: Allow module collapse by default
fields.help: Off by default. Projects inherit this unless they explicitly enable collapse.

fields.label: Show module title bars by default
fields.help: When title bars are hidden, modules render cleanly without LOOM chrome and user collapse controls are unavailable.

fields.label: Initial module state
fields.help: Only applies before a visitor has a saved collapse state.
